<!-- openqodex:start -->
Before any push in a repository that has an OpenQodex settings file (`.openqodex/config.yaml`, or `.openqodex.yaml` at its root), review the change with the openqodex skill.
<!-- openqodex:end -->

When that review is due, and whenever you are asked to review the changes, run `/home/dev/.openqodex/bin/openqodex guide skill` from the repository and follow what it prints: the review procedure of the OpenQodex version installed here.
